jobs.occupation: Qualified Electricians Wanted for Projects Across Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you a qualified electrician looking for new opportunities in Denmark? Due to increasing demand from our clients, Viktech is continuously looking for skilled electricians for a wide range of projects within construction, industrial installations, service, and maintenance.

As an electrician at Viktech, you will work on exciting projects with established companies throughout Denmark. We offer both short-term and long-term assignments depending on your qualifications and preferences.

Your tasks may include:

• Electrical installations in commercial and residential buildings• Cable pulling and cable management systems• Installation of lighting systems• Installation and maintenance of electrical equipment• Industrial electrical work• Service and maintenance assignments• Troubleshooting and fault finding• Working from technical drawings and documentation

Requirements

We are looking for candidates who:

• Hold a valid electrician qualification or apprenticeship certificate• Have practical experience as an electrician• Can work independently and take responsibility for assigned tasks• Have a strong focus on quality and safety• Are reliable and punctual• Speak English at a communicative level (Danish is an advantage but not required)

We Offer

• Competitive salary according to Danish collective agreements• Salary paid every two weeks• Pension scheme and health insurance• Professional workwear and necessary safety equipment• Support from a dedicated contact person throughout your employment• Opportunities for long-term cooperation and continuous projects• Assistance with practical matters related to working in Denmark

About Viktech

Viktech is a specialized staffing and recruitment company supplying qualified tradespeople to the construction, electrical, and technical industries throughout Denmark.

India Spice is a passionate Indian restaurant and catering kitchen with a deep love for rich flavors, authentic spices, and traditional culinary craftsmanship.

We are best known for our vibrant North and South Indian specialties, aromatic curries, andtandoor dishes, but most importantly, we believe in making authentic food from scratch,using fresh, high-quality ingredients and taking pride in the tradition behind everything we serve.

For us, India Spice is about more than serving great meals. It is about warm hospitality, creating memorable dining experiences, and treating our guests, team members, and partners with respect. We are an ambitious, growing business, but we also want India Spice to be a workplace where people take pride in what they do, enjoy coming to work, and feel a shared responsibility for our quality and standards.

Currently, our operations cover our busy restaurant service, takeaway, and event catering, and we are looking for the right person to take responsibility for the day-to-day organization and operational flow of our kitchen.

About the position

As our Kitchen Manager, you will play a central role in keeping the kitchen structured, efficient, and running smoothly across daily prep, restaurant service, and catering orders.

Key Responsibilities:

• Overall coordination and operational organization of the kitchen

• Maintaining strict hygiene and food safety standards according to Danish Fødevarestyrelsen regulations

• Staff scheduling and daily task delegation for kitchen and prep staff

• Overseeing kitchen maintenance, ensuring equipment, tandoors, and workstations remain clean and in peak condition

• Purchasing, ordering ingredients, spices, packaging, and operational supplies

• Inventory management and stock control to ensure availability for high-volume weekends and large catering orders

• Establishing clear prep routines, portion control, and workflow improvements as our catering demands expand

• Collaborating closely with our chefs and front-of-house team to ensure consistent food quality and punctual service

Qualifications & Qualities:

• Experience working in a professional kitchen, catering operation, or food production environment is an advantage, but having the right mindset is what matters most.

• You are structured, dependable, and punctual, with natural ownership over your responsibilities.

• You are proactive, notice details quickly, and thrive when bringing order and smooth routines to a fast-paced environment.

• You communicate clearly and comfortably in English (Danish is a plus, but not required).

Practical Information

• Position: Kitchen Manager

• Hours: Full-time (37 hours per week)

• Location: Søborg Hovedgade 118, 2860 Søborg

• Salary: Competitive, based on qualifications and experience

• Start Date: As soon as possible / By agreement

How to apply

Send your application and CV to info@indiaspice.dk with the subject line "Application: Kitchen Manager – India Spice".

If you have any questions regarding the role or India Spice, feel free to contact us at info@indiaspice.dk.

We review applications continuously and look forward to hearing from you — and hopefully welcoming you to the India Spice family.

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Development of High Temperature Heat Pumps with Thermal Energy Storage - DTU Construct
jobs.description:
Do you want to start your research career by making industrial heat clean, flexible and affordable? At DTU Construct you will work at the forefront of technologies key to decarbonizing industries: high-temperature heat pumps and high-temperature thermal energy storage.We invite applications for a fully funded PhD position in the Thermal Energy Section of the Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at the Technical University of Denmark. The position is part of HeatMinds, a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Network funded by Horizon Europe. HeatMinds brings together 6 universities and research institutes and 12 industrial and research partners across Europe to develop industrial high-temperature heat pumps and thermal energy storage. Your project will develop new Carnot Battery technologies: systems that combine heat pumps based on high temperature thermodynamic cycles together with high-temperature thermal energy storage, such as molten salts and dual-media packed beds. These systems will deliver clean process heat while also giving industry flexibility on the electricity market.Supervision: Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli and Prof. Anders Christiansen Erlandsson with industrial secondments. Responsibilities and qualificationsYour overall goal will be to find out how industrial high temperature heat pumps can benefit from integrated thermal energy storage by developing new cost-effective, high-performance hybrid configurations. You will work with fellow doctoral candidates across the network and with industrial partners in Denmark and abroad.Your main tasks will be:
• Develop and Design new architectures comprising cycles using natural working fluids and thermal energy storage, optimised for efficiency, cost, and fast response to electricity price signals
• Carry out multi-objective optimisation and dynamic system analysis of alternative layouts
• Validate results by carrying out experiments and data comparison during industrial secondments, turning the results into innovations with real-world impact (e.g. patents, future commercial solutions) 
• Publish in international journals, present at conferences and take part in HeatMinds network training, summer schools and outreach.You have:
• A solid background in engineering thermodynamics, heat transfer and energy technologies, e.g. conversion or storage systems 
• Familiarity with modelling and numerical simulations, for example for MSc thesis or student projects 
• Programming skills, preferably in Python, Matlab, Modelica or similar 
• Excellent written and spoken English, and the motivation to work in an international, goal-oriented environment.MSCA eligibility: at the time of recruitment, you must not already hold a doctoral degree. You must also not have resided or carried out your main activities (work, studies, etc) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before your recruitment date.You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.Approval and Enrolment The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. We offerDTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.Salary and appointment termsThe appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. The PhD salary will be based on the Marie S. Curie compensation scheme conditions and according to the grant agreement. Based on seniority the candidate will receive a minimum of DKK 30.264,08 (base salary) and DKK 1580,90 (PhD supplement). In addition, DTU will also pay pension consisting of 18,07%. Finally, it is possible to apply for family allowance. The period of employment is 3 years. The position is a full-time position. Starting date is anticipated as 1 April 2027, or according to mutual agreement. You can read more about career paths at DTU here.Further informationFurther information may be obtained from Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli, adrsc@dtu.dk and Prof. Anders Christiansen Erlandsson, acerl@dtu.dk. You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk. If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. Application procedure Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 24 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:
• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• A copy of thesis (if available) or other publications (if available)
• A short critical literature review (max. 3 pages) on high-temperature heat pumps combined with thermal energy storage (e.g. Carnot Batteries): select up to 5 relevant publications and explain your choice, compare their methods & findings, identify possible open research questions, explaining how your background would help you address them. Include at least one figure or table of your own making.You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. jobs.occupation: Investment Analyst / Investment Manager - Green Energy & Infrastructure
jobs.employer_name: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by making green commercial investments across Africa, Asia, and Latin America?

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark’s largest impact fund and is internationally recognized as a best-in-class impact investor.  We manage our own private equity funds, debt capital, and concessional capital with a focus on creating sustainable businesses that deliver measurable social, economic and climate impact alongside solid financial returns.

We are strengthening our Green Energy and Infrastructure team and are looking for an Investment Professional to join us in our headquarters in Copenhagen. Depending on your experience, you may join us as Investment Analyst or Investment Manager.

Green Energy and Infrastructure invests in businesses and infrastructure that accelerate the green transition in emerging markets. Our investment focus spans renewable energy, circular economy, electric mobility, and water infrastructure. Through equity and debt investments, active ownership and strategic partnerships, we drive impact and value creation aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals. We typically invest between DKK 100-350 million per transaction.

You will be reporting to a Managing Director in Green Energy and Infrastructure and work closely with colleagues in Copenhagen and our regional offices across Europe, Africa, Asia and Latin America on investments throughout the investment lifecycle.

 

Investment Analyst

As an Investment Analyst, you will be a key analytical resource in transaction teams, focusing on commercial and financial analysis of investment opportunities.

You will:

• 
Screen and analyse new investment proposals using Impact Fund Denmark’s tools and processes.

• 
Assist in preparing investment papers, financial analyses and financial modelling.

• 
Support due diligence, valuation and deal structuring.

• 
Contribute to preparing and presenting investment recommendations and materials for the investment committee and board.

• 
Collect and analyse commercial and financial data for deal teams.

• 
Help maintain information systems for pipeline tracking and portfolio data.

• 
Participate in networking activities to support investment sourcing and promotion.

• 
Support project managers in active ownership and portfolio monitoring.

• 
Ensure timely and accurate updates of systems with project documents, and financial and sustainability reporting.

• 
Assist in assessing exit timing and support execution.

 

Qualifications:

• 
Master’s degree in a relevant field, such as finance or economics with strong academic results.

• 
1-2 years of relevant experience from impact investing, private equity, M&A, corporate finance or consulting.

• 
Solid understanding of financial analysis and valuation.

• 
Skilled user of Excel and with an interest in and aptitude for financial modelling.

• 
Detail-oriented with a structured working approach.

• 
Fluent in English (written and spoken).

• 
Curious to broaden your understanding of the world and keen to travel.

 

Investment Manager

As an Investment Manager, you will take the lead on many of the tasks performed by an Investment Analyst. You are thus expected to work independently, drive workstreams, and take ownership of parts of the investment process.

You will:

• 
Screen and analyse new investment proposals using Impact Fund Denmark’s tools and processes.

• 
Lead preparation of parts of investment papers, financial analyses and financial modelling with guidance from the project manager (Senior Investment Manager or Investment Director).

• 
Support and lead due diligence, valuation and deal structuring workstreams.

• 
Contribute to preparing and presenting investment recommendations and materials for the investment committee and board.

• 
Lead the analysis of commercial and financial data for deal teams.

• 
Take part in negotiating terms and drafting legal documentation.

• 
Help maintain information systems for pipeline tracking and portfolio data.

• 
Participate in networking activities to support investment sourcing and promotion.

• 
Support project managers in active ownership and portfolio monitoring.

• 
Assist in assessing exit timing and support exit negotiations and execution.

 

Qualifications:

• 
Master’s degree in a relevant field such as finance or economics with strong academic results.

• 
3-5 years of relevant experience from impact investing, private equity, M&A, corporate finance or consulting.

• 
Independent mindset and experienced in owning and managing workstreams.

• 
Solid understanding of financial analysis and valuation.

• 
Expert user of Excel and with an interest in and aptitude for financial modelling.

• 
Detail-oriented with a structured working approach.

• 
Fluent in English (written and spoken).

• 
Strong interpersonal skills and business judgment.

• 
Curious to broaden your understanding of the world and keen to travel.

• 
Experience in emerging markets and green energy is an advantage but not a prerequisite.

 

Working at Impact Fund Denmark

Learning is an important element of working in Impact Fund Denmark, and we will support your personal development through training, sparring and by ensuring that you get exciting and challenging tasks and new opportunities for growth. When joining Impact Fund Denmark, you will take part in our extensive onboarding program to get the best possible start in your new role.

We have a diverse and inclusive working environment with more than 170 talented individuals from 30+ different nationalities. We work seamlessly together with colleagues around the corner, across the organisation and between offices in Asia, Africa, Latin America and Europe.

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at Impact Fund Denmark

About the Position:

Pleje Trafik ApS is a growing transport and passenger services provider. As our operations expand, we are seeking a dependable Fleet and Logistics Administrator to join our team. In this position, you will work from our office to manage day-to-day administrative tasks, coordinate schedules, and support our active team of drivers.

Key Responsibilities:

• Manage Driver Schedules: Create, update, and manage the weekly work schedules and shift rotations for all company drivers.

• Route Planning & Coordination: Plan and organize daily driving routes to make sure pickups and drop-offs are punctual and efficient.

• Track Booking Platforms: Monitor incoming transport bookings from municipal portals, regional booking systems, and company clients.

• Driver Communication: Act as the main point of contact for drivers on the road, handling daily updates, shift changes, and basic work queries.

• Office Administration: Keep digital records of vehicle logs, maintenance dates, and general operational paperwork.

Qualifications and Skills:

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage timetables and schedules.

• Good communication skills; fluency in English or another secondary language is highly valued.

• Reliable, responsible, and capable of working independently to keep office tasks on track.

• Basic computer skills to manage online booking systems and spreadsheets.

• Previous experience in office work, scheduling, or customer service is a plus but not mandatory.

What We Offer:

• A stable full-time position (37 hours per week).

• A professional office workspace within an established company.

• Salary is negotiable at a professional level, matching the administrative responsibilities of the role.

How to Apply:

Please submit your CV and a brief application letter directly through this portal. Applications are reviewed continuously.

Samsøe Samsøe is looking for a Social Media Lead to shape and drive our global social media presence.

We are looking for a self-driven and experienced profile with a strong understanding of social media, fashion and culture, combined with a great eye for content. You know what makes an image or video work, understand how different platforms behave and can turn ideas into relevant, engaging content.

This is a role with a high level of ownership, combining strategic direction with hands-on content creation. You will work closely with Brand, Creative, Marketing, and E-commerce to ensure Samsøe Samsøe shows up on social in a way that feels distinctive, relevant and true to the brand.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• 
Own and continuously develop the global social media strategy for Samsøe Samsøe.

• 
Lead the planning and execution of the social content calendar across Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest and emerging platforms.

• 
Translate collections, campaigns and brand stories into strong, platform-native social concepts and content.

• 
Create social-first photo and video content independently when relevant, from ideation and shooting through to editing and publishing.

• 
Bring a strong visual perspective to our channels, with a solid understanding of photography, videography, composition, lighting, movement and editing.

• 
Identify opportunities for agile and low-production content alongside larger campaign and brand productions.

• 
Work closely with Creative and Brand teams to develop content while maintaining a strong and consistent visual identity and tone of voice.

• 
Identify cultural moments, conversations, trends and emerging formats relevant to the Samsøe Samsøe universe – and know which ones are right for the brand.

• 
Develop strategies for community growth and engagement, building a relevant and engaged global audience.

• 
Partner with E-commerce and Performance Marketing to support commercial priorities while protecting and strengthening the brand.

• 
Manage content publishing, channel optimisation and ongoing platform development.

• 
Use data and audience insights to understand performance, identify opportunities and continuously improve our approach.

• 
Define and report on relevant social KPIs, translating performance into clear recommendations and actions.

• 
Stay ahead of developments in social media, fashion, culture and digital behaviour and proactively bring new ideas into the organisation.

• 
Manage relevant external partners, creators and agencies when needed.

YOUR PROFILE

You bring a strong combination of social media expertise, creative judgement and hands-on content skills. You understand fashion and visual culture and have a clear sense of what makes content relevant to both a brand and its audience.

You are self-driven and comfortable taking ownership. You spot opportunities, develop ideas and make things happen without needing constant direction. You have the maturity and judgement to make decisions independently while working collaboratively across teams.

We imagine that you:

• 
Have 4+ years of relevant experience in social media and content creation, ideally within fashion, lifestyle or another culturally relevant industry.

• 
Have a strong visual eye and practical photography, videography and editing skills.

• 
Understand social-first storytelling and how to create content specifically for different platforms.

• 
Have a deep understanding of Instagram, TikTok and the wider social landscape.

• 
Combine strategic thinking with the ability and willingness to create and execute yourself.

• 
Have a strong understanding of fashion, brands, culture and emerging creative formats.

• 
Are proactive, resourceful and confident taking an idea from concept to execution.

• 
Are comfortable using data and insights to inform creative and strategic decisions.

• 
Can manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.

• 
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

As our workforce is increasingly more international, our corporate language is English. If you can identify with our concept and our ambitions, we look forward to receiving your application.

We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and encourage everyone to apply for the position, regardless of age, national and cultural background, gender identity, religion, sexual orientation, or disability.

Do people describe you as a storyteller? Are you the friend who always ends up explaining the history, recommending the hidden café, or connecting the dots? Do you love Copenhagen — not just the postcard version, but the layers beneath it?

We focus on small groups, meaningful conversations, and experiences that feel natural rather than scripted. Our tours are relaxed, human, and built around connection. We value calm, confident leadership. We value thoughtful storytelling that adapts to the group. We value presence, awareness, and reading the room. Our guests come from all over the world — from curious leisure travellers to corporate and VIP groups. What they all appreciate is authenticity, quality, and a genuine sense of welcome rather than being processed.

Plan to stay and grow here

Speak fluent English (additional languages are a strong plus)
